title: From Career Confusion to the Right Next Step
problem_statement: Education and Careers: From Aspiration to an Achievable Plan
challenge: Women often receive generic course recommendations that ignore existing skills, career breaks, affordability, family responsibilities, confidence, accessibility and actual employment opportunities.
solution: CareerPath AI is a context-aware GenAI career and learning navigator that helps women identify a realistic career destination, understand their transferable and missing skills, create an achievable learning plan, build employer-visible evidence and recover when they fall behind.
innovation: Instead of starting with courses, CareerPath AI starts with the person. It considers existing strengths, experience, constraints, time, budget and career goals before generating a personalized path.

success_moment.before: I want to restart my career, but I do not know where to begin.

recommended_demo_persona: Woman returning after a career break
